kind: Independent non-author connected source review and automated component regression execution

disposition: No actionable defect found within the frozen Work state/acknowledgment delta; seven existing connected regression cases independently pass. Compiled browser reproduction/retest remains separately owned by root.

reviewedInvariants.evidence: Work key includes actor, client and exact task, excluding update time; separate source views do not reuse another actor/client/task draft.
Form is fresh native task overlaid only with explicit edited fields. PATCH includes only changed allowed fields. Untouched completion/resolution are never copied from stale form state.

Each edit retains its native before value. Noncolliding changes use the current native token; a changed edited field uses the original edit token and produces the existing conflict path with retained local text.
Fresh done status is displayed and disables status editing. Source-completed resolution is retained; saving unrelated planned text changes neither Finding validation nor assessment/Evidence state.
A confirmed response rebases edits only when returned task_id and client_id match. Equal accepted values clear; newer local text remains with the accepted baseline and token.
Retry uses the original exact body and Idempotency-Key. Newer local text is retained through acknowledgment and then saved as a separate delta using the confirmed current token.
Existing mayEdit/allowed-field checks remain in the UI; read-only fixture exposes disabled fields and no save/complete command. Server authorization and CAS are unchanged and remain authoritative.
